title: BAI Announces Level 1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly contributing to player development across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a Level 1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team event, shaping competition and talent identification within India.

title: Final Selection Trials List Announced for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
